description: Toolbox panel showing available diagram stencils that can be dragged onto the canvas.

parameters.name: CollapseCategoriesExceptFirst
parameters.description: When true (the mobile Shapes sheet), every category except the first (General/basic) starts collapsed — applied once; the user's own expand/collapse choices win afterwards.

parameters.name: PreferredStencilIds
parameters.description: Fáze 15 (the Modeling "Open in editor" notation palette): stencil ids to pin as the FIRST library — the palette of the active notation — while every other library starts collapsed (search still spans the whole stencil library). Order is preserved; unknown ids are ignored. Null (the default) keeps today's toolbox: no pinned library, all palettes expanded.

parameters.name: PreferredStencilsLabel
parameters.description: Header label of the pinned library (the Modeling dialog passes the notation profile's display name). Null falls back to the localized TmDiagramToolbox_PreferredDefault. Ignored while PreferredStencilIds is unset.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: When true, stencil tiles are inert: not draggable, aria-disabled, no insert on click or keys (the editor passes its effective read-only state).

parameters.name: ShowTitle
parameters.description: Whether the panel renders its own heading. Hosts that already label the panel (a tab, a sheet tab) pass false. Defaults to true.

parameters.name: StencilDragStart
parameters.description: Raised when a stencil drag starts.

parameters.name: StencilKeyboardInsert
parameters.description: Raised when a focused stencil item is activated from the keyboard.
